-- Spec: parity(x) is True when the byte has an odd number of set bits.

-- Helper spec: count of set bits in a byte.
ones(x: u8) -> int =
  post out >= 0
  post out <= 8
  ex ones(255) == 8
  ex ones(0) == 0
  var v = x
  var c = 0
  for i in range(0, 8)
    if v % 2 == 1
      c += 1
    v = v // 2
  c

-- True when ones(x) is odd.
parity(x: u8) -> bool =
  post out == (ones(x) % 2 == 1)
  ex parity(7) == True
  ex parity(3) == False
  ones(x) % 2 == 1
